# Workspace Project Instructions

- Build a modern Angular banking document processing application.
- Include sign-in and sign-out flows for users.
- Include Aadhaar and PAN document upload and verification screens.
- Include document status tracking and a responsive dashboard.
- Use Angular standalone components, TypeScript, and Angular routing.
- Use local mock data only; do not require external APIs or credentials.
- Keep all generated UI polished, responsive, and accessible.

## Project Status

The Angular 17 project has been scaffolded and customized as DocDesk. Sign-in routes to a guarded dashboard. Mock authentication persists in browser local storage. The app includes Aadhaar and PAN queue entries, status badges, upload actions, verification progress, sign-out, responsive navigation, and compiled successfully.
